content.text:
The robot followed the corridor to its end and is now resting in front of the green panel, about 0.6 m from it. Collision protection stopped it from getting closer. It crouched and switched the motors off after I called `rest`.

The corridor ran straight, turned left, then ran straight again to the panel. A couple of wall-hugging stops on the way needed small sidesteps. There were no falls.
